description: Stateful monitor callable with plain query params: GET /s/api-change-check/watch?token=my-api-prod&url=https://example.com/openapi.json . Fetches your public OpenAPI 3 JSON; first call stores a baseline, later calls return only what changed. Price: $0.01 per call in USDC on Base (eip155:8453), paid with x402 in params._meta["x402/payment"]. HTTP: GET https://api.firstmention.uk/s/api-change-check/watch

token.description: Private label for this monitored API, 8-64 chars of letters/digits/-/_

url.description: Public http(s) URL of your OpenAPI 3.0/3.1 JSON document
